title: (Biographies) William Wilberforce
description: In this sermon, the speaker discusses the perseverance and determination of William Wilberforce in his fight for the abolition of the slave trade. Wilberforce faced numerous defeats, criticism, and long hours of work, but he remained steadfast in his mission. He acknowledged his own guilt and took responsibility for allowing the slave trade to continue. Despite the challenges, Wilberforce's indomitable joy and love for his family remained, and he found solace in playing with his children even after parliamentary defeats.
